definitions.explanation: Punishment from heaven or the gods for wrongdoing. Used both literally in religious/traditional contexts and figuratively to express that someone deserved their misfortune.

examples.japanese: {天罰|てんばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧。
⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{天罰|てんばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you do something like that, you'll be punished by heaven.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪事|あくじ}→悪事：29054_akuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねた→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{天罰|てんばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People whispered that it was divine punishment for all the evil deeds committed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ (heaven) + ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧ (punishment). Expresses the idea that wrongdoers will eventually face retribution from a higher power. In modern usage, it is often used semi-figuratively to mean "serves them right" or to warn someone that their bad behavior will catch up with them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天罰|てんばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧ — divine punishment descends
- {天罰|てんばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ — to be struck by divine punishment
- {天罰|てんばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to receive divine punishment
- {天罰|てんばつ}てきめん — swift and sure divine retribution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧ — punishment; general term, not necessarily divine
- ⟦{報|むく}い→報い：15680_mukui⟧ — retribution, karma; consequence of one's actions, without the "heavenly" connotation
- {天誅|てんちゅう} — divine retribution; stronger, more archaic, historically used to justify executing wrongdoers
